model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представлява групирана стълбовидна диаграма, която илюстрира сравнение на резултатите на четири различни метода — DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection и PPO — по няколко категории, чиито етикети по хоризонталната ос не са напълно четливи поради отрязване в долната част на изображението. Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите, подредени в определен ред, като за всяка категория са представени до четири стълба, съответстващи на четирите метода. Вертикалната ос представя числови стойности, но конкретните етикети и мащабът не са ясно видими поради ограничената резолюция на изображението; въпреки това стълбите варират от относително ниски стойности в лявата част на диаграмата до значително по-високи стойности в дясната част. Всеки метод е визуално разграничен чрез цвят и шарка: DAPO е представен със сини стълби с диагонални щрихи, SRPO — с плътни оранжеви стълби, PPO+Self-reflection — с плътни тъмнозелени стълби, а PPO — със зелени стълби с диагонални щрихи. В първата група категории стълбите са с относително ниски стойности, като DAPO изглежда най-висок сред тях. В средните групи стойностите нарастват постепенно, като DAPO и SRPO показват сходни височини. В последната група вдясно стълбите достигат най-високите си стойности, като DAPO и SRPO имат най-високите стълби в тази група, следвани от PPO+Self-reflection и PPO. Диаграмата съдържа легенда в горната лява част, която идентифицира четирите метода чрез съответните им цветове и шарки.
model_annotations.Chinese: This grouped bar chart compares the performance of four methods—DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across multiple categories whose labels along the horizontal axis are partially obscured or cut off. The vertical axis represents a numerical measure, though its label and specific tick values are not clearly visible; the scale appears to range roughly from 0 to a value near the top of the tallest bars. Each group of bars contains up to four bars corresponding to the four methods: DAPO is depicted with blue bars featuring diagonal hatching, SRPO is shown in solid orange, PPO+Self-reflection is rendered in solid dark green, and PPO is displayed with green bars featuring diagonal hatching. Across the visible groups, the bars generally increase in height from left to right along the horizontal axis, with the rightmost group containing the tallest bars overall. In the first group, the bars are relatively short and similar in height, with DAPO appearing slightly taller than the others. In the second group, DAPO and SRPO are moderately taller, while PPO+Self-reflection and PPO remain shorter. The third group shows a noticeable increase, with SRPO reaching a height comparable to DAPO, and PPO+Self-reflection growing as well. In the final and tallest group, DAPO and SRPO reach their peak values, with SRPO appearing to be the tallest bar in the entire chart, followed closely by DAPO, then PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trailing slightly behind but still substantially tall. The bars within each group are arranged side by side in the consistent order of DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO from left to right. There is no apparent special visual emphasis such as bolding or annotations on any individual bar, and the groups appear to follow the natural order of the category labels along the horizontal axis.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart presents a grouped bar comparison of four methods—DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across what appear to be multiple categories along the horizontal axis, though the category labels are obscured or cut off at the bottom of the image. The vertical axis represents a numeric scale, but its label and tick values are not clearly visible, making exact value readings difficult. The legend at the top identifies four bar types: DAPO is shown with blue hatched (diagonal lines) bars, SRPO is depicted with solid orange bars, PPO+Self-reflection is represented by solid dark green bars, and PPO is shown with green hatched (diagonal lines) bars. Each category group contains up to four bars arranged side by side in the order DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. Across the visible groups, the bars generally increase in height from left to right across the categories, with the rightmost group displaying the tallest bars overall. In the first group, the solid blue bar (which may represent an unlabeled variant or overlap with DAPO) is the tallest at roughly 30–35% of the chart height, while SRPO and PPO are shorter. In the middle groups, the bars are moderate in height, with DAPO and SRPO appearing relatively close in value. In the rightmost group, SRPO reaches the highest point on the chart, followed closely by a solid blue bar, PPO (green hatched), and PPO+Self-reflection (dark green), all of which are notably taller than bars in earlier groups. Some groups appear to have missing bars for certain methods. The bars are not sorted by value within groups but follow a consistent categorical ordering, and no bars appear to be specially emphasized beyond their color and pattern distinctions.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt einen Vergleich von vier verschiedenen Methoden dar – DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection und PPO – über mehrere Kategorien hinweg, deren Beschriftungen auf der horizontalen Achse jedoch aufgrund der Bildauflösung nicht vollständig lesbar sind. Die vertikale Achse zeigt numerische Werte, wobei die genaue Beschriftung und Skalierung ebenfalls nicht eindeutig erkennbar sind; die Werte scheinen sich jedoch in einem Bereich zu bewegen, der von niedrigen Werten nahe null bis zu höheren Werten erstreckt. Die Legende am oberen Rand des Diagramms ordnet die vier Methoden ihren jeweiligen Farben und Mustern zu: DAPO wird durch blau schraffierte Balken (diagonale Linien) dargestellt, SRPO durch orangefarbene Balken mit Vollfüllung, PPO+Self-reflection durch dunkelgrüne Balken mit Vollfüllung und PPO durch grün schraffierte Balken (diagonale Linien). Die Balken sind gruppiert angeordnet, wobei jede Gruppe auf der horizontalen Achse einer Kategorie entspricht und innerhalb jeder Gruppe die vier Methoden nebeneinander stehen, in der Reihenfolge DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection und PPO von links nach rechts. Es sind mindestens vier Gruppen erkennbar. In der ersten Gruppe weisen alle vier Balken relativ niedrige Werte auf, wobei DAPO den höchsten Balken zeigt und die übrigen drei Methoden ähnlich niedrige Werte aufweisen. In der zweiten Gruppe sind die Werte insgesamt etwas höher, wobei DAPO und SRPO ähnliche Werte erreichen und PPO+Self-reflection sowie PPO etwas niedrigere Werte zeigen. In der dritten Gruppe steigen die Werte weiter an, mit DAPO und SRPO auf vergleichbarem Niveau und PPO+Self-reflection sowie PPO leicht darunter. In der letzten und am weitesten rechts liegenden Gruppe erreichen die Balken die höchsten Werte im gesamten Diagramm, wobei DAPO und SRPO die höchsten Balken aufweisen, gefolgt von PPO und PPO+Self-reflection. Insgesamt zeigt das Diagramm eine Tendenz zu steigenden Werten von links nach rechts über die Kategorien hinweg, und die Balken sind nicht in einer auf- oder absteigenden Reihenfolge innerhalb der Gruppen sortiert, sondern folgen der konsistenten Reihenfolge der Legende. Es sind keine besonderen visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Umrandungen oder Annotationen an einzelnen Balken erkennbar.
